description: Create a draft invoice or quote for a customer. KENJTEC calculates the totals. A draft has no number; issue_invoice gives it one.

currency.description: ISO 4217, e.g. EUR, USD, BDT. Default: the sender's currency.

intro.description: A line above the items, for example a greeting.

kind.description: An invoice, or a quote the customer has to accept first.

lines.description: The items on the invoice, in the order they should be printed.

unit_price.description: Net price per unit in cents.

outro.description: A line below the items, for example payment terms or thanks.

service_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — required to issue an invoice.

tax_exempt.description: True when no VAT is charged — then say why in tax_note. Ask the user; do not decide it for them.

tax_note.description: Why no VAT is charged, printed on the document (for example: reverse charge, small business).

name: create_invoice
title: Create invoice draft
